title: Set or clear one role's access rule for a scope (prepare)
description: Step 1 of 2 for change a role's access rule. Validates the arguments and returns a signed confirmation_hash plus a message to surface to the user. The user must reply with the literal word "confirm" before you call the matching -execute tool with the hash. Original action: Sets the level every member of one role gets for one scope. A role rule wins over the default, and a member's own rule wins over it. The scope is the project (`resource: project` with the project id as `resource_id`, level `none`, `member` or `admin`), a whole tool (`resource: dashboard`, level `none`, `viewer`, `editor` or `manager`), one object (add `resource_id`), or one property (`resource: property_definition`, level `none`, `read` or `read_write`). A project level of `none` blocks access to the project and its resources. A null `access_level` removes the role's rule. An empty result means the rule is cleared. Role rules are enforced only on plans with role-based access. Read access-control-roles-list with `role_id` first and tell the user the current and new level before asking for confirmation. Requires human typed confirmation.
